name: Cedar Course Co. - Weekly Support Report (demo, not live)

parameters.content:
## Weekly report
Every Monday 08:00 (set your timezone in Workflow Settings). Reads the "Conversations" and "Refunds" sheets, counts the last 7 days, posts to Slack.

To email it instead: disable "Post to Slack", enable "Email Report (optional)", add an SMTP credential.

Both sheets are read in full: fine for a small shop, not for a very large log.

meta.templateNote: Demo on made-up data. Not imported into or run on a live n8n instance and not connected to a live WhatsApp number. No credential is configured: every credential is a placeholder with id REPLACE_ME.
